intended_object: A natural isomorphism. Given an isomorphism {1} ⋙ F ≅ F, it is the restricted isomorphism between the restricted functor (P.ι ⋙ F lifted into Q) precomposed with the restricted shift, and that same restricted functor. Inferred from the docstring and from its use in LaurentK0.forgetGrading and related files.
explanation: This definition is a construction step, not a notion from the literature. It takes an isomorphism of functors and carries it over to full subcategories. To do so it rewrites with `fullSubcategory_shift`, which says the shift on the subcategory is the ambient shift restricted to it. It then builds the isomorphism after composing with the inclusion into Q and pulls it back using the fact that this inclusion is fully faithful (`preimageIso`). The library uses it only as data passed to `forgetGrading` and the K₀ results about resolving subcategories. Mathematically it is just "restrict the given isomorphism", so there is no standalone object whose faithfulness could be judged.
